ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming-contbatch-usw2 p99 latency spike > 1.2s and SLO breach detected (routing layer). auto-page on-call. thread_ts=1767777001
Alex M.: oncall here, seeing the alert. dashboards?
Priya S.: I'm on it, checking per-model and per-route breakdowns now.
Marco L.: I saw a smaller alert earlier around 1767776800 about a scheduler tweak deployed 10m ago. could be related.
Jin (Support): CS reporting multiple customer UI timeouts — AcmeAnalytics and BeaconOps callouts. Jin: Acme says "embedding streaming stuck" and errors in console.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-1767777001 - sustained p99 > 1.2s on continuous-batcher (streaming). paging list: Alex M., Priya S., Marco L.
Alex M.: Ok. Priya, can you share top-heavy models or queues?
Priya S.: quick numbers: streaming contbatch overall p95 320ms -> 420ms, p99 480ms -> 1300ms. spike concentrated on mixed-seq route /v1/stream and model variant r-inf-7b-q4.
Priya S.: Per-host breakdown shows 3 hosts in pool with heavy long-request batches (seq_len > 1200) queuing up. small streaming token requests get stuck behind them.
Marco L.: That matches a cross-queue starvation pattern. Scheduler is batching by arrival and packs long sequences which inflate pack time. preemption not kicking in quickly because fairness weights are skewed.
Alex M.: Is this the continuous-batching path (not streaming-native)?
Priya S.: yes, continuous-batcher is used for streaming on that route. we saw an optimizer commit to increase pack window from 8ms -> 20ms 12m ago to improve throughput; might be amplifying padding & tail latency.
Samira (SRE): Confirmed — change 1767776742 toggled pack_window_ms to 20 in us-west2. rollback candidate.
Jin (Support): Customer impact: AcmeAnalytics reports ~40% session timeouts; BeaconOps has smaller but noticeable spikes. CS already notified customers in channel #cs-notify with initial note.
Alex M.: Immediate mitigation options? list them so we can act fast.
Priya S.: 1) revert pack_window change (fast but will reduce throughput)
Priya S.: 2) apply a soft cap on batch_size for streaming route (max_batch_tokens=512)
Priya S.: 3) set streaming requests to higher scheduling priority (stream_priority=true) and give fairness boost to small requests
Priya S.: 4) route streaming traffic to fallback variant r-inf-3b while we debug (degrade quality)
Marco L.: I'd add 5) enable preemptive_shed for oversized batches (preempt large pending packs after N ms)
Alex M.: Which is fastest? Marco: what about toggling priority flag?
Marco L.: Priority flag is config-only and can be rolled in ~30s to route config. pack_window rollback is also quick. Fallback model route requires deploy of route rules but we have a quick toggle in config.
Alex M.: Let's do priority + short-term batch cap. If that doesn't improve in 5m, revert pack_window. Jin, confirm we've told the two impacted customers ETA ~15-30m.
Jin (Support): Yep, messages sent. will update with mitigation progress.
Priya S.: Executing: set route /v1/stream -> streaming_priority=true, set max_batch_tokens=512 on contbatch config (us-west2).
Priya S.: running command now:
```
# edit route config
redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/stream --region usw2 --set streaming_priority=true --set max_batch_tokens=512
```
Marco L.: Watching metrics and tracer. logs show pack window still at 20ms on hosts until rollout picks up.
Alex M.: Any signs of regression?
Priya S.: 90s after change: p99 dropped from 1.3s -> 780ms, p95 ~380ms. progress but still above SLO.
Samira (SRE): We have a few hot hosts still with long KV-lookup times. adding KV eviction to free cache for streaming might help too.
Marco L.: Also noticed a couple of large background batching jobs from internal evals hitting same pool. can we isolate eval traffic to dedicated pool? not immediate but worth noting.
Alex M.: For now, can we preempt the large pending packs? is preemptive_shed toggle available?
Priya S.: Yes, it's a runtime flag. flipping it for region now:
```
redwoodctl runtime update --region usw2 --set preemptive_shed=true --qos preempt_threshold_ms=30
```
Priya S.: flipped.
Marco L.: After preemptive_shed on, p99 back to 520ms. p95 ~340ms. still above goal but much better.
Jin (Support): CS update: Acme sees improvement — sessions recovering, some clients still reporting transient errors. I'm sending an update to customers.
incident-bot: Note: mitigation applied: streaming_priority, max_batch_tokens cap, preemptive_shed=true — monitor for 15m.
Alex M.: Good. Next: longer-term fix — revert pack_window change and/or tune scheduler pack heuristics to avoid packing long sequences with many small streaming requests. Priya, can you tee up a rollback?
Priya S.: I'll prepare the rollback MR and schedule a controlled revert in 30m if metrics hold. also adding a fallback route to r-inf-3b as a last-resort automated failover if p99 spikes again.
Marco L.: Add an autoscaling rule: if queue depth for contbatch > 50 and p99 > 800ms, spin up isolated pool for streaming-only. That should prevent cross-queue interference.
Alex M.: Agreed. Samira, can you handle postmortem template and capture timeline & customer impact? include the 12m pack_window change as root candidate.
Samira (SRE): On it. I'll create PM and attach logs/traces, list of commands we ran, and timeline.
Jin (Support): I'm collating customer impact notes and CS messages. will attach to PM.
Priya S.: Metrics look stable for 10m: p99 490ms, p95 360ms. I'll keep watch for 20m.
Alex M.: If stable at 20m, we'll close the paging. Otherwise escalate to infra.
Priya S.: Handoff: I'm on for next 2h and will follow up. Alex, handoff to Priya if you need to go offline.
Alex M.: Thanks everyone. I'll update rotation and mark on-call handoff to Priya at end of this minute window.
Samira (SRE): Postmortem draft created: PM-1767777001 in /docs/incidents. Tagging Priya/Marco/Jin.
Jin (Support): Final customer note queued depending on final stability.
Alex M.: Closing remark: root cause likely pack_window change + mixed sequence length amplification causing cross-queue starvation. Immediate mitigations worked: priority, cap, preemption. Follow-ups: revert or retune pack_window, isolate evals, autoscale streaming-only pool, add regression tests.
incident-bot: Incident INC-1767777001 status: mitigated -> monitoring. assigned owners: Priya S., Marco L., Samira (SRE).
Priya S.: I'll keep monitoring and will update this thread. :thumbsup:
Alex M.: Great job team. handing off to Priya. :white_check_mark:
